environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted'. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-privilege-escalation' with validationFailureAction: Enforce applies mutating admission that strips any securityContext.privileged field and rejects pods with hostPath volumes. The OPA Gatekeeper constraint K8sPSPHostFilesystem is active with an empty allowedHostPaths list. Container runtime is gVisor (runsc) with platform=systrap which intercepts all syscalls through its sentry process, preventing direct kernel memory manipulation even if heap corruption achieves code execution. The combination means: (1) no privileged escalation possible, (2) no host filesystem access for persistence, (3) gVisor's memory-safe sentry prevents syscall-based container escape even with arbitrary code execution from heap corruption.
